title: XikeStor 8-Port 10G SFP+ L3 Web Managed Ethernet Network Switch

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
XikeStor 8-Port 10G L3 Web Managed Ethernet Switch – High-Speed 8-Port 10G SFP+ with VLAN, Port Aggregation & Routing


Upgrade your network with the XikeStor 10G L3 Web Managed Ethernet Switch, designed for ultra-fast data transmission, advanced Layer 3 routing, and seamless network management. Featuring 8× 10G SFP+ ports, this switch ensures lightning-fast connectivity for data centers, enterprises, and high-performance networks.


Key Features:

  • 8× 10G SFP+ Ports – Supports high-speed fiber connections for maximum bandwidth
  • L3 Web Managed – Advanced routing, VLAN segmentation & traffic control
  • Three-tier managed storage forwarding
  • Primary chip: Ruiyu RTL9303
  • Backplane bandwidth of 160Gbps
  • Packet forwarding rate 119.05Mpps
  • MAC address 16K
  • VLAN Support – Secure & optimize network performance with VLAN division
  • Port Aggregation (LAG) – Combines multiple ports for enhanced bandwidth & redundancy
  • Plug & Play Setup – Hassle-free installation with an intuitive web interface
  • Enterprise-Grade Performance – Ideal for gaming, cloud computing, data centers & ISP networks
